lesson: Abstain when the expected edge is below the required threshold, even if the market moves positively.
Trade only when the expected edge exceeds the cost threshold
Abstain only when the expected edge is positive; a negative edge estimate led to missing a profitable trade.
Abstain when the expected edge is negative, even if the market moves positively.
Abstaining on a -0.0476% edge missed a +0.386% return; avoid abstaining when edge is near zero and potential upside exists.
Abstaining missed a +0.97% gain; consider that negative edge estimates can still precede positive moves.
Abstain only when the expected edge is clearly positive; a small negative edge led to missing a 0.92% gain.
Abstain only when the expected edge is below the threshold; a negative edge estimate that turns positive indicates the model missed a trade.
